summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent of an FCA disclosure notice) on 2 November 2026 notifying the market of total voting rights under FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1R. Issued share capital at 31 October 2026 was 4,316,320,246 ordinary shares of 31 pence each, of which 270,881,064 were held in treasury, leaving 4,045,439,182 total voting rights. No transaction, price, premium, stake, advisor or board recommendation is involved. The figure serves as the denominator for DTR interest notifications. No special situation exists; nothing for risk-arb watch.
